## Introduction

**Goal:** Evaluate the compute efficiency of different models over different
sample sizes.

**Data:** For model evaluation, data are simulated according to the generative
model.

**Method:** Models are timed during training on chronologies with six Gaussian
clusters, crossing interval length (500, 2500, and 12500 years) with sample size
(500 to 5000), with 8 replicates per combination. Simulations run in parallel
with one torch thread per process, so absolute times reflect single-threaded
performance.

## Data

```{r}
#| label: intcal20

intcal20 <- structure(
  read.csv("data/intcal20.csv"),
  class = c("Calibration", "data.frame"),
  curve = "IntCal20"
)

intcal20 <- intcal20 |>
  transform(f14c_mu = exp(-c14_age / LIBBY)) |>
  transform(f14c_sigma = f14c_mu * c14_error / LIBBY)
```

## Timing

```{r}
#| label: timing-scenarios

timing_grid <- expand.grid(
  n_samples = seq(500, 5000, by = 1500),
  n_years = c(500, 2500, 12500),
  replicate = seq_len(8)
)
```

We are still running in parallel, which is probably not best for benchmarks, but
we these tests are not meant to be absolutely perfect anyway. But to keep thread
contention to a minimum, we limit the number of parallel clusters to eight (half
the number available on this machine).

```{r}
#| label: model-timing
#| cache: true
#| output: false
#| time_it: true

# set up clusters
clusters <- makeCluster(8)

fns <- c(
  "bgmm.R",
  "calibrate.R",
  "ckde.R",
  "constants.R",
  "dataframe-helpers.R",
  "dpmm.R",
  "mixture-helpers.R",
  "netc14.R",
  "sample-dates.R",
  "simulate-chronology.R",
  "spd.R"
)

clusterExport(
  clusters,
  varlist = c("fns", "intcal20", "timing_grid"),
  envir = environment()
)

clusterEvalQ(clusters, {
  library(carbondate)
  library(torch)
  torch_set_num_threads(1)
  lapply(file.path("R", fns), source)
})

# run simulations in parallel, one scenario at a time
timing_results <- parLapplyLB(clusters, seq_len(nrow(timing_grid)), \(iter) {
  set.seed(STARGATE + iter)

  # scenario
  n_years <- timing_grid[["n_years"]][iter]
  n_samples <- timing_grid[["n_samples"]][iter]
  n_clusters <- 6
  start <- sample(seq(100, 49500 - n_years), 1)
  end <- start + n_years - 1

  # simulate chronology, draw samples, and calibrate
  chronology <- simulate_chronology(start, end, n_clusters)
  samples <- sample_dates(chronology, n_samples, intcal20)
  calibrated_dates <- calibrate(samples, intcal20)

  # training
  models <- list(
    ckde(calibrated_dates),
    bgmm(calibrated_dates),
    dpmm(samples),
    netc(calibrated_dates),
    spd(calibrated_dates)
  )

  data.frame(
    iter = iter,
    replicate = timing_grid[["replicate"]][iter],
    model = c("CKDE", "BGMM", "DPMM", "NetC14", "SPD"),
    start = start,
    n_years = n_years,
    n_samples = n_samples,
    n_clusters = n_clusters,
    elapsed = sapply(models, attr, which = "elapsed")
  )
})

# close parallel processes and collect results
stopCluster(clusters)
timing_results <- do.call(rbind, timing_results)
```

Save results.

```{r}
#| label: save-timings
write.csv(
  timing_results,
  "data/timing-results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Results

```{r}
#| label: plot-elapsed
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false
xy <- aggregate(
  elapsed ~ model + n_samples + n_years,
  FUN = median,
  data = timing_results
)

xlim <- range(xy[["n_samples"]])
y_step <- 150
ylim <- c(0, y_step * ceiling(max(xy[["elapsed"]]) / y_step))

x_ticks <- seq(500, 5000, by = 1500)
y_ticks <- seq(ylim[1], ylim[2], by = y_step)

widths <- c(2.05, 0.15, 1.65, 0.15, 1.65, 0.15, 0.7)

svglite(
  filename = "figures/evaluate-timing.svg",
  width = sum(widths),
  height = 2.5,
  pointsize = 10
)

layout(matrix(c(1, 0, 2, 0, 3, 0, 4), nrow = 1), widths = widths)

par(defaults)

for (yrs in unique(xy[["n_years"]])) {
  xy_yrs <- xy[xy[["n_years"]] == yrs, ]

  par(mai = c(0.4, if (yrs == 500) 0.45 else 0, 0.25, 0))
  new_plot(xlim, ylim)
  add_grid(h = y_ticks, v = x_ticks)

  for (mdl in unique(xy_yrs[["model"]])) {
    i <- which(xy_yrs[["model"]] == mdl)
    x <- xy_yrs[["n_samples"]][i]
    y <- xy_yrs[["elapsed"]][i]

    clr <- theme(mdl)
    cbg <- if (mdl == "SPD") "#FFFFFF" else theme(mdl, shade = -0.6)

    lines(x, y, col = clr, lwd = 0.5)
    points(x, y, pch = 21, col = clr, bg = cbg, cex = 1)
  }

  x_axis(at = x_ticks)

  if (yrs == 2500) {
    x_label("N Samples")
  }

  if (yrs == 500) {
    y_axis(at = y_ticks)
    y_label("Elapsed [s]")
  }

  main(paste(yrs, "Years"), col = coolors("gray"))
}

par(mai = rep(0, 4))
new_plot(c(0, 1), c(0, 1))
add_legend(
  x = 0.0,
  y = 0.7,
  legend = c("BGMM", "CKDE", "DPMM", "NetC14", "SPD"),
  pt.bg = c(theme("BGMM", "CKDE", "DPMM", "NetC14", shade = -0.6), "#FFFFFF"),
  col = theme("BGMM", "CKDE", "DPMM", "NetC14", "SPD"),
  text.col = theme("BGMM", "CKDE", "DPMM", "NetC14", "SPD"),
  pch = 21,
  pt.cex = 1.1,
  lwd = 0.5,
  title = "Models"
)

dev.off()
```
